title: SIsA1: the A1 clause (|DN| <= K on the zero grid) is discharged under the named input [IS-S] - the reverse S->DN conversion |d| <= |sDefect d| + 1/8 + the increasing-gauge composition give the single data-free K = Sbound(x_M) + 1/8, and W2B3.a1_universal_o1 then delivers the S1-vs-Rsum oscillation bound (Sbound(x_M) + 1/8)·(17/8) with K read off Ismail's bound alone - NO RH CLAIM
facts: ROLE: W2B3.a1_universal_wire / a1_universal_o1 closed the far-side kernel HALF of the S1-vs-Rsum oscillation under the walk-side A1 clause (|DN N0 Nas j| <= K on the zero grid); the data-free universal K was that module's open item (the measured K = 2.615067 / certified K = 31047116350.923088 ledger constants cover only the certified (10^7, 3e10] band). This module supplies the universal K from the named input [IS-S] (SIs, 0414): Ismail's explicit |S(T)| <= c1 log T + c2 log log T + c3 for T >= e.

THEOREMS (formal/RhAttack/SIsA1.lean, namespace SIsA1, all LEAN-PROVEN): (1) dn_pt_sPlusShift / dn_le_sPlusShift - the REVERSE S->DN conversion: |d| = |sDefect d + 1/8| <= |sDefect d| + 1/8 (triangle; mirror of W2SAtZeros.sDefect_le_dnPlusShift, which did DN -> S). (2) sgrid_dn_bound - the increasing-gauge composition: an S-defect bound by Sbound(x_j) at each grid node lifts to |d_j| <= Sbound(x_M) + 1/8 over any ascending grid x_j in the gauge domain (via SIs.sboundMon). (3) ismail_sgrid_dn - the named-input bridge: [IS-S] itself gives |d_j| <= Sbound(x_j) + 1/8 at each node (single hypothesis: the RVM identification |S(x_j)| = |sDefect (DN N0 Nas j)| at the grid nodes, the exact 1/8-shift identity of W2SAtZeros.rvmShiftCore; the O(1/T) RvM count remainder is a data-side note immaterial at frontier scale). (4) boundPos: the gauge is strictly positive on [e, inf) (c1 log T, c2 log log T, c3; log T >= 1, log log T >= 0). (5) a1_o1_from_ismail - THE O(1) CONSEQUENCE: for any ascending zero grid x_0 = g1 <= ... <= x_M in the gauge domain (frontier start g1 >= 2t), the A1-triple (hA1_0, hA1M, hA1) is discharged by [IS-S] + identification with K := Sbound(x_M) + 1/8, and W2B3.a1_universal_o1 delivers |S1Sum - RSum| <= (Sbound(x_M) + 1/8)·(17/8) - the oscillation amplitude read off the named input alone, no measured ledger K needed.

SCALE: at the frontier (grid starting at tPT2 = 3 000 175 332 800, top x_M at the current census frontier where Sbound(x_M) < 6 by SIs.pinBracketLt6 + monotonicity over a frontier-scale span) the amplitude is < (6 + 1/8)·(17/8) = 49/8 · 17/8 = 833/64 ~ 12.9 - a named-input O(1) constant for the kernel-half oscillation at the frontier (versus the certified ledger K = 31047116350.92 which gives an absurd 6.9e10 - the named input is the point).
